# Internationalization

Applies when the change touches: more than one language or region. Every role loads this pack for the steps it works in, on top of its own playbook. The test commands below are best practices the gate runs: put them in the Spec's `[[tests.commands]]`, so a red one blocks the merge. Name the pack in the Spec's Context; it does not count against a Task's `skills`.

## Standards

| Standard | Edition | Checked | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Unicode CLDR | current release | 2026-09-28 | <https://cldr.unicode.org/> |
| BCP 47 language tags | RFC 5646, 2009 | 2026-09-28 | <https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc5646> |
| ICU MessageFormat | ICU MessageFormat 2; CLDR current; BCP 47 | 2026-09-28 | <https://unicode-org.github.io/icu/userguide/format_parse/messages/mf2.html> |
| W3C internationalization best practices | current | 2026-09-28 | <https://www.w3.org/International/techniques/authoring-html> |
| Translated documentation: XLIFF for exchange, gettext for source strings, and a translation memory that keeps glossary terms stable | XLIFF Core 2.1 (OASIS Standard); gettext, current | 2026-09-28 | <https://docs.oasis-open.org/xliff/xliff-core/v2.1/xliff-core-v2.1.html> |

## Checklist by loop step

| Step | Item |
| --- | --- |
| Entry (`aidd next`) | A change that adds or reorders user-visible text, or formats dates, numbers, or names, touches every locale. |
| Specify | The locales in the Acceptance; text expansion, right-to-left, and pluralization cases named. |
| Implement | No concatenated strings; ICU MessageFormat for plurals and gender; locale-aware formatting from CLDR; UTF-8 end to end. |
| Review | No hard-coded locale, time zone, or encoding; pseudo-localization passes. |
| Ship | Translation coverage per locale tracked; a missing string falls back visibly, never silently. |

## Test commands

| Command | Proves | How |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Pseudo-localization build | no truncation or concatenation in any screen | a pseudo-locale build in CI |
| Message-format lint | every message parses and has complete plural categories | an ICU MessageFormat linter |
| Locale snapshot tests | dates, numbers, currencies, and names format per locale | snapshot tests over the supported locales |
| RTL layout tests | the changed screens mirror correctly | screenshot tests in an RTL locale |
| Translation coverage | every key exists in every shipped locale | a coverage check over the message catalogs |

## Keep it current

A standard marked emerging is a draft, a first edition, or a young practice: apply it only when the change clearly needs it, and say so in the Spec. A standard checked more than a year ago is stale: `aidd eval standards` lists it, and the loop contract's research-first rule applies. When the change needs a standard this pack lacks, look up the authoritative source, record the edition in the Spec's Context, and propose the update to the aidd project's roles registry (`schemas/roles.json` in the aidd repository) as an improvement.
